Lists all orderings available to the conference series endpoint. These values can be used by the order parameter when listing conference series.

Lists conference series in the Pure instance that matches the provided query, similar to the GET version, instead of using parameters to alter the response, an JSON document is posted with the request. The JSON document contains fields for all the parameters available for the GET version, but also additional filtering options.
